changelog: WARNING: Always backup your database before updating
REMOVED: Username & Password fields from Add/Edit Server — NBI port 7557 does not require auth
REMOVED: Refresh All Offline feature — prevents browser hang on 1000+ offline devices
REMOVED: Regex fallback in Find by Tag — prevents 30s timeout on 2500+ devices
FIX: Summon now verifies device response via _lastInform check — no more fake success
FIX: Reboot now verifies device response — returns accurate offline status
FIX: Refresh (Device Detail) pre-checks device status before running refresh steps
FIX: Force Sync online threshold reduced from 20min to 5min — matches GenieACS behavior
FIX: Device count & Statistics now use local database — no more slow API calls
UI: Offline visual state — hero red gradient, identity strip red, section headers white-to-red
UI: Section bodies show red overlay with offline badge icon when device is offline
UI: Edit/Add buttons disabled when offline, Refresh and Summon/Reboot remain active
UI: Unified error message — Device is offline or unreachable
PERF: Device count queries local DB instead of fetching all IDs from GenieACS API
PERF: Statistics computed from local DB — no API calls on Manager dashboard
author: ExodiaForb
